package.description: Shows permissions assigned to Windows services in an easy to read format instead of SDDL like the built in Windows tools

en-US.description: Shows permissions assigned to Windows services in an easy to read format instead of SDDL like the built in Windows tools
en-US.longDescription:
Using built in Windows commands such as "sc.exe /sdshow" to view the permissions set on services produces an output in SDDL format, which is not easy to read or understand. This tool provides an easy to use GUI alternative to view permissions on Windows services as well as the Service Control Manager itself.

Features
- Easy to use, intuitive GUI. No SDDL knowledge required!
- Query services on the local machine or on remote machines
- View permissions on the Service Control Manager itself (scmanager)
- Copy the SDDL format of any service's permissions to your clipboard, for use with other tools
- More features coming in full release after BETA
en-US.name: Service Permissions Reporter BETA

zh-CN.description: 以易读格式显示 Windows 服务的权限分配，而非内置 Windows 工具使用的 SDDL 格式
zh-CN.longDescription:
使用 Windows 内置命令（如“sc.exe /sdshow”）查看服务权限时，输出的 SDDL 格式不易阅读和理解。本工具提供了一个易于使用的图形界面替代方案，可查看 Windows 服务及服务控制管理器本身的权限。

功能特点
- 简单直观的图形界面，无需了解 SDDL！
- 可查询本地或远程计算机上的服务
- 查看服务控制管理器（scmanager）本身的权限
- 将任意服务的权限 SDDL 格式复制到剪贴板，供其他工具使用
- 更多功能将在正式版中推出（当前为测试版）
